wiki.wikiDescription: Charred Ley-Sap: Lv 11-15 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Gather volatile Ember Sap from the smoldering caverns of Emberroot Hollows.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 11+).

objectives.description: Collect 6 Ember Sap vials in Emberroot Hollows

lines: Geothermal vents beneath Emberroot Hollows are overheating the lantern foundations.
Harvest Ember Sap from the cinder-beasts so we can insulate the conduits.
This sap burns hotter than Runewick prism fuel.
The Hollow-Heart Elder must be behind this magma surge.

wiki.wikiDescription: Crown of Ash: Lv 13-15 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Defeat Ignivar, Hollow-Heart Elder to unlock the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 13+).

objectives.description: Defeat Ignivar, Hollow-Heart Elder in Emberroot Hollows

lines: Ignivar feeds magma directly into the Shattered Lumenworks above.
Topple the Hollow-Heart Elder before the upper spire cracks.
The magma tremors have quieted, revealing the entrance to the Shattered Lumenworks.
One final ascent awaits.

wiki.wikiDescription: Crown of Ash: Lv 13-15 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Defeat Ignivar, Hollow-Heart Elder to unlock the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 13+).

wiki.wikiDescription: The Road to Solstice: Lv 6-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Unlocks travel to the central hub of Solstice and opens the Sunken Causeway.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 6+).

objectives.description: Clear 5 Causeway Shellbacks along the Sunken Causeway approach

lines: Welcome to Solstice, traveler. Four mayors sent word you survived your home Rift.
Prove your mettle on the Sunken Causeway approach so our gates stay open.
The Causeway road is clear enough for supply wagons once more.
Stay sharp—deeper shared Rifts beneath Solstice demand everything you have.

wiki.wikiDescription: The Road to Solstice: Lv 6-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Unlocks travel to the central hub of Solstice and opens the Sunken Causeway.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 6+).

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Anomalous Refraction: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Investigate shifting harmonic resonance in the Shattered Threshold.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

lines: The Lumen Gate's resonance drifted 4% overnight.
Steel Watch insists it's 'haunted,' which is adorable, but I prefer data—clear the threshold and bring me readings.
The initial resonance readings confirm my hypothesis.
The crystalline threshold is stabilizing, but the galleries deeper in are fracturing.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Anomalous Refraction: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Investigate shifting harmonic resonance in the Shattered Threshold.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Light in the Glass: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Gather rare Prism Motes from fractured crystal galleries.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

lines: Sunhaven claims the Gates respond to 'pure intentions.'
If intentions balanced a mana equation, half my apprentices wouldn't have singed eyebrows.
These Prism Motes exhibit fascinating harmonic properties.
Prepare yourself—the core warden has broken containment.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Light in the Glass: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Gather rare Prism Motes from fractured crystal galleries.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Shattered Warden: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Subdue the corrupted Shattered Warden in Runewick Vaults.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

objectives.description: Defeat Vaelkor the Shattered Warden in Area 3 (The Prism Vaults)

lines: The Shattered Warden has locked the vault matrix.
Dispel its harmonic field before the whole spire shatters.
Vaelkor wasn't a construct—he was guarding a fragment of something ancient and fractured.
Deliver this seal to Chancellor Vance in Solstice immediately.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Shattered Warden: Act I storyline quest in runewick.
wiki.lore: Subdue the corrupted Shattered Warden in Runewick Vaults.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Dean Seraphina Voss in runewick.

wiki.wikiDescription: Broken Relays: Lv 16-20 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Salvage Astral relay coils from the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 16+).

objectives.description: Collect 6 Lumen Coils in Shattered Lumenworks

lines: The upper conduits flicker between blinding Light and crushing Dark.
Recover intact Lumen Coils before the Overclocked Archon triggers a full overload.
With these coils, we can stabilize Solstice lanterns—if you silence Vesperon.
Step into the core chamber when ready.

wiki.wikiDescription: Broken Relays: Lv 16-20 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Salvage Astral relay coils from the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 16+).

wiki.wikiDescription: The Archon of Solstice: Lv 18-20 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Lv 20 capstone quest confronting Vesperon, Overclocked Archon in the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 18+).

objectives.description: Defeat Vesperon, Overclocked Archon in Shattered Lumenworks

lines: Vesperon, Overclocked Archon fused with the central lantern core during the first Rift.
End the Astral Overdrive and restore Solstice balance.
Solstice shines steady once more, hero. All four mayors owe you their cities.
Yet deeper Rifts beyond Lv 20 are already stirring on the horizon.

wiki.wikiDescription: The Archon of Solstice: Lv 18-20 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Lv 20 capstone quest confronting Vesperon, Overclocked Archon in the Shattered Lumenworks.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 18+).

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Tempered Steel: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Defend outer iron vaults against rattling constructs.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

lines: Gates are sparking like a bad anvil, and Runewick's robe-nerds blame 'leyline harmonics.'
Put on real steel and go hit whatever's rattling the outer vault.
Outer vault's quieted down, but the forge shafts are still rumbling.
Good swing, recruit. Keep your guard up for what's deeper.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Tempered Steel: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Defend outer iron vaults against rattling constructs.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Slag & Sparks: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Gather essential Forge-Cores from the fiery galleries.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

lines: Vesperwood scouts keep bragging they don't need armor if they never get hit.
Funny—last one who visited here tripped over a cobblestone and asked for a bandage.
Those Forge-Cores will keep our smelters burning through the month.
Now drink an elixir and prepare for the lower vault.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Slag & Sparks: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Gather essential Forge-Cores from the fiery galleries.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Iron Warden: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Confront Korrath the Iron Warden at the heart of the Ironspire.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

objectives.description: Defeat Korrath the Iron Warden in Area 3 (The Ironspire Vaults)

lines: Korrath has awakened in the lower depths and the anvil is cracking.
Show that ancient bucket of bolts what modern steel can do.
Korrath dropped a shard that hums like an old Astral tuning fork.
Take it to Vance in Solstice—and don't let those Sunhaven choir-kids polish it.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Iron Warden: Act I storyline quest in steel_watch.
wiki.lore: Confront Korrath the Iron Warden at the heart of the Ironspire.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Forge-Mayor Hilda Ironheart in steel_watch.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Shadows on the Steps: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Cleanse courtyard steps of encroaching Gloom Shades.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

lines: Bright morning, initiate! Even with shadows leaking out of the courtyard Gate, it's a lovely day to smite something.
Just remember to actually heal yourself if you get clipped.
The courtyard steps are radiant once more.
The pilgrims can pray in peace, though the deeper cloisters remain shadowed.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Shadows on the Steps: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Cleanse courtyard steps of encroaching Gloom Shades.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Tide & Stone: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Collect radiant Sun-Beads from deep cloister halls.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

lines: Vesperwood's mayor told me our hymns are 'too loud for stealth.'
Naturally, I offered to sing softer while they practice dodging.
The Sun-Beads radiate pure dawn energy.
Drink deep of the light—Malakor's choir sings in the lowest sanctum.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Tide & Stone: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Collect radiant Sun-Beads from deep cloister halls.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Eclipsed Choir: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Silence Malakor and recover the humming Astral shard.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

objectives.description: Defeat Malakor the Eclipsed Choir in Area 3 (The Dawnlit Sanctum)

lines: Malakor's darkened bells threaten to drown out the dawn hymn entirely.
Silence the choir and bring radiant peace to the sanctum.
A cold Astral fragment was humming inside Malakor's bells.
Take it to Lord Chancellor Vance in Solstice—and bring snacks, the poor man looks exhausted.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — The Eclipsed Choir: Act I storyline quest in sunhaven.
wiki.lore: Silence Malakor and recover the humming Astral shard.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by High Steward Cassian Dawn in sunhaven.

wiki.wikiDescription: Sluicegate Survey: Lv 6-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Investigate the breached aqueducts of Sunken Causeway.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 6+).

objectives.description: Collect 5 Sluice Shards in Sunken Causeway

lines: Floodwater from the southern sluiceways is seeping into the Grand Bazaar.
Bring back Sluice Shards so our artificers can trace the breach.
These shards pulse with Water and Earth harmonics—something is holding the gate shut.
Prepare to confront the Causeway Warden.

wiki.wikiDescription: Sluicegate Survey: Lv 6-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Investigate the breached aqueducts of Sunken Causeway.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 6+).

wiki.wikiDescription: Breach of the Floodworks: Lv 8-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Slay Thalossos, the Mire-Bell to open the descent toward Emberroot Hollows.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 8+).

objectives.description: Defeat Thalossos, the Mire-Bell in Sunken Causeway

lines: Thalossos, the Mire-Bell has barricaded the central floodgate and threatens to drown the lower ward.
Watch for its Sluicegate Crush telegraph and break its hold.
The waters are receding, though smoke now rises from the deeper roots below.
Rest in the Commons before descending into Emberroot Hollows.

wiki.wikiDescription: Breach of the Floodworks: Lv 8-10 Solstice shared-zone quest.
wiki.lore: Slay Thalossos, the Mire-Bell to open the descent toward Emberroot Hollows.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Lord Chancellor Aurelius Vance in Solstice (Lv 8+).

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Rustle in the Canopy: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Scout out disturbed boughs and pacify Zephyr Sprites.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.

lines: Don't jump—I've been standing behind you for three minutes.
The canopy Gate's acting up, and Steel Watch offered to 'fix it with a hammer.' Go scout it before they flatten a tree.
The boughs are settled for now, but the wind carries strange omens.
Clean your blades and prepare for the trail ahead.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.1 — Rustle in the Canopy: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Scout out disturbed boughs and pacify Zephyr Sprites.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Briar & Frost: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Traverse Mossglen Trail and collect high-canopy Gale Plumes.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.

lines: Arcanists in Runewick think math explains the wind.
Let them calculate why a Briar Stalker just chewed through their courier's satchel.
Six Gale Plumes in hand. The canopy winds are stabilizing.
Stay light on your feet—Sylvara nests just above.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.2 — Briar & Frost: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Traverse Mossglen Trail and collect high-canopy Gale Plumes.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — Matriarch of the Gale: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Defeat Sylvara in the apex canopy of Vesperwood.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.

objectives.description: Defeat Sylvara the Gale Matriarch in Area 3 (The Galehollow Canopy)

lines: Sylvara's tempest threatens to tear the boughs apart.
Take to the high canopy and bring down the storm.
Found a glowing Astral splinter in Sylvara's nest.
Head to Solstice and hand it to Chancellor Vance—try not to wake him if he's still drafting trade treaties.

wiki.wikiDescription: Quest 1.3 — Matriarch of the Gale: Act I storyline quest in vesperwood.
wiki.lore: Defeat Sylvara in the apex canopy of Vesperwood.
wiki.acquisitionSource: Offered by Warden-Mayor Sylvan Reed in vesperwood.
